## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 107 captures during May 2026. Activity was completed in line with the planned operating arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported interruptions to the scheduled capture activity, and the available sessions supported the expected level of service for the month.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally satisfactory. Graders marked 4 captures as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 3.7. These images could not be assessed for grading purposes and were excluded from the results that could be assigned a grading outcome. The ungradable findings should continue to be reviewed through routine quality monitoring, with attention to any recurring factors affecting image acquisition.

## Grading

A total of 22 captures were graded as referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed promptly during May 2026. The site should continue to maintain the current session and review arrangements, while monitoring image quality and grading timeliness in subsequent reporting periods.
